The treatise examines the subject of destinies (*gati*), analyzing the paths and realms of rebirth within Buddhist doctrine. SuttaCentral notes four modern translations of the text in four different languages [SuttaCentral].

Canonical connections are also found with the *Paṭiccasamuppādavibhaṅga* of the *Vibhaṅga* (Vb 6) and portions of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (*Sattakanipāta*, AN 7; *Aṭṭhakanipāta*, AN 8) [DharmaNexus].
